sources.title: GitHub - thebalddudeco/shadowframe-ai
sources.snippet: The base-model selector is mode-aware. The Visual Style area only shows Original plus LoRAs built for the selected checkpoint, preventing incompatible LoRAs from being mixed with the wrong model family. Shadowframe AI passes consensual adult prompts directly to the selected local ComfyUI workflow.
